name: openkk

scripts.check: npm run build:packages && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.check:generated: npm run check:master-data && npm run check:service-workers && npm run check:dependency-graph
scripts.check:full: npm run audit:production && npm run check:generated && npm run check && npm run build:apps && npm run test:e2e:export:built && npm run test:e2e
scripts.build:packages: npm run clean:packages && npm run build -w @rubydogjp/openkk-client-domain -w @rubydogjp/openkk-server-domain -w @rubydogjp/openkk-client-ports -w @rubydogjp/openkk-server-ports -w @rubydogjp/openkk-client-usecases -w @rubydogjp/openkk-server-usecases -w @rubydogjp/openkk-client-ui -w @rubydogjp/openkk-server-api -w @rubydogjp/openkk-client -w @rubydogjp/openkk-server -w @rubydogjp/openkk-print-adapter -w @rubydogjp/openkk-file-db-adapter -w @rubydogjp/openkk-memory-db-adapter -w @rubydogjp/openkk-embedded-backend -w @rubydogjp/openkk-embedded-backend-adapter -w @rubydogjp/openkk-frontend
scripts.test:e2e:export:original: npm run build -w @rubydogjp/openkk && npm run test:e2e:export:built

description: オープン会計 — open-source double-entry bookkeeping library for sole proprietors. Hexagonal architecture with swappable backend and storage adapters.
author: rbdog <rbdog@rubydog.jp>
